name: H1 - Unit Class Comparison: Infantry vs Recon on Open Field
hypothesis: H1: ReconSquad with superior detection range and mobility will detect InfantrySquad first and gain a first-strike advantage, winning the majority of 1v1 engagements.
description: One InfantrySquad vs one ReconSquad on an open 20x20 field. Both start 18 tiles apart facing toward the center. The open field removes cover/LoS variables, isolating the impact of detection range, mobility, and combat stats.
expected_observations: ReconSquad should win >65% of engagements due to 12 vs 6 detection range and 3 vs 2 mobility, despite lower HP and firepower.
